items.title: GTA 6 might not cost $100, but most of the people pre-ordering it are buying it at that price, Take-Two reveals
items.summary: Though many may baulk at the idea of paying $100 (£90) for a game, a lot of the people who pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto 6 bought the more expensive Ultimate edition rather than the $80 (£70) Standard edition.
